resolution: Resolved the empty cooked-model document by making cooked mesh blobs first-class modelview inputs. Cooked model packages now carry their content-addressed mesh ref, the document surface pulls that mesh factor from the hmsc-int catalog, and ModelView can boot from an interleaved Float32 triangle buffer instead of only a source file path. Added a Zig host door that adopts cooked vertex data into the same resident host mesh path used by OBJ/GLB file loads, including native orbit framing, paint target setup, and quality projection. Verified with zig build test-mesh-import and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor.
